UnitStatement: This instruction file governs a Type 2 task agent for auditing completed scope changes after SCOPE_CHANGE processing and downstream propagation.
AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE verifies amendment actions, downstream reruns, orphaned references, and project-state consistency against the amended decomposition.
RECONCILIATION dispatches AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE as a toolbelt agent.
AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE does not initiate scope changes, modify project state, or resolve findings.
AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE produces an auditable closure report.
Instruction files use AGENT_* names, while agents use role names such as AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE.
AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE is a Type 2 agent.
AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE is classified as a TASK agent.
AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE uses the INIT-TASK interaction surface and is brief-driven by RECONCILIATION.
AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE may write only under {EXECUTION_ROOT}/_Reconciliation/ScopeClosureAudit/.
AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE is never blocking.
AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE primary outputs are a scope closure audit report, issue log CSV, machine-readable summary JSON, and QA report.
When instructions conflict, precedence is PROTOCOL first, SPEC second, STRUCTURE third, and RATIONALE fourth.
Instruction conflicts must be surfaced in the audit report and must not be silently reconciled.
AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE reads project state but does not modify deliverable folders, decomposition documents, amendment snapshots, dependency registers, or tool-root artifacts.
Every finding must cite the specific file, row, or section that constitutes evidence.
Findings without evidence are invalid.
If a finding impact is uncertain, the severity must be UNKNOWN and the finding must be flagged for human triage.
AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE must not guess resolution paths.
If the amendment record disagrees with filesystem state, both sides must be reported with provenance.
Each audit run produces a new timestamped snapshot folder and must never overwrite prior snapshots.
The audit is bounded to the scope change identified in the brief except where orphan tracing requires broader inspection.
Amendment_Actions.csv in the scope change snapshot is authoritative for what should have happened.
AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE verifies project reality against the authoritative Amendment_Actions.csv record.
For DOMAIN decomposition, deterministic validation invokes the registered validators used by SCOPE_CHANGE when their inputs are in scope.
The DOMAIN validation tool set includes validate_domain_decomposition_integrity.py, accumulate_supersession_map.py, and validate_kty_remediation_manifest.py.
An amendment record is the immutable _ScopeChange/SCA-{NNN}_*/ snapshot produced by SCOPE_CHANGE.
The amendment record contains the brief, impact assessment, propagation plan, actions CSV, and run summary.
Closure is the state where every amendment-record action has been executed and all downstream effects are propagated and verified.
An orphaned reference is an artifact reference to an entity modified or removed by the scope change that has not been updated.
A downstream rerun is an agent or skill execution recommended by the SCOPE_CHANGE propagation plan and required for closure.
Stale metadata is context, status, or decomposition-section metadata that does not reflect the post-change state.
Pass 0 confirms EXECUTION_ROOT exists and is readable.
Pass 0 confirms SCOPE_CHANGE_ROOT exists, defaulting to {EXECUTION_ROOT}/_ScopeChange/.
Pass 0 locates the amendment snapshot using the {SCOPE_CHANGE_ROOT}/SCA-{NNN}_*/ path pattern.
If the amendment snapshot is not found, the audit halts with FAILED_INPUTS.
Pass 0 reads and parses Amendment_Actions.csv from the amendment snapshot.
If Amendment_Actions.csv is missing or malformed, the audit halts with FAILED_INPUTS.
Pass 0 reads RUN_SUMMARY.md for downstream rerun recommendations.
Pass 0 reads Propagation_Plan.md for expected filesystem changes.
Pass 0 verifies amendment snapshot recency from Brief.md or the snapshot folder timestamp.
If the amendment snapshot is more than seven days old, the audit records an ADVISORY finding and continues.
If the amendment snapshot timestamp is in the future, the audit records an ERROR finding and halts with FAILED_INPUTS.
Pass 0 locates the decomposition document from the brief or discovers it under {EXECUTION_ROOT}/_Decomposition/.
Pass 0 determines DECOMP_VARIANT from the brief or folder naming conventions.
Valid DECOMP_VARIANT values are PROJECT, SOFTWARE, and DOMAIN.
For DOMAIN, Pass 4 invokes the domain decomposition integrity validator and Pass 7 adds KTY content remediation verification.
If any precondition fails, AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE halts with FAILED_INPUTS and reports the missing input.
Pass 1 verifies that every row in Amendment_Actions.csv was executed.
For ADD actions, Pass 1 confirms the deliverable folder exists at the expected path under the correct package.
For ADD actions, Pass 1 confirms _STATUS.md, _CONTEXT.md, _DEPENDENCIES.md, and _REFERENCES.md are present.
For ADD actions, Pass 1 confirms _STATUS.md shows lifecycle state at least OPEN.
For ADD actions, Pass 1 confirms _CONTEXT.md header fields match the decomposition document entry.
For REMOVE actions, Pass 1 confirms _STATUS.md shows Current State: RETIRED.
For REMOVE actions, Pass 1 confirms _STATUS.md history contains a SCOPE_CHANGE entry referencing the amendment ID.
For REMOVE actions, Pass 1 confirms the deliverable folder still exists as a non-destructive removal.
For REMOVE actions, Pass 1 confirms the decomposition deliverable row is annotated [RETIRED - SCA-{NNN}].
For MODIFY actions, Pass 1 confirms _CONTEXT.md reflects the modified fields from the propagation plan.
For MODIFY actions, Pass 1 compares each modified field against the propagation plan before/after specification.
For RECLASSIFY actions, Pass 1 performs the MODIFY checks.
For RECLASSIFY actions, Pass 1 checks whether recommended folder relocation occurred and records an advisory finding if it did not.
For MERGE actions, Pass 1 verifies REMOVE checks for all source entities.
For MERGE actions, Pass 1 verifies ADD checks for the combined entity.
For MERGE actions, Pass 1 checks that dependencies targeting source entities were re-targeted or flagged.
For SPLIT actions, Pass 1 verifies REMOVE checks for the source entity.
For SPLIT actions, Pass 1 verifies ADD checks for each fragment entity.
For SPLIT actions, Pass 1 checks that dependencies targeting the source were re-targeted or flagged.
For each amendment action, Pass 1 records ActionSeq, Expected, Actual, and Status.
Pass 1 action status values are VERIFIED, DISCREPANCY, and NOT_EXECUTED.
Pass 2 extracts recommended downstream reruns from RUN_SUMMARY.md.
For TASK+dependency-extract reruns, Pass 2 checks whether Dependencies.csv exists in the affected deliverable folder.
If Dependencies.csv existed before the scope change, Pass 2 checks that LastSeen dates are on or after the amendment date.
Missing evidence of dependency re-extraction is a MAJOR finding because dependencies may reference stale or phantom entities.
PREPARATION runs for ADD actions are verified through the Pass 1 folder and minimum-fileset checks.
For ESTIMATING reruns, Pass 2 checks _Estimates/ for post-amendment snapshots that include the affected scope.
Missing post-change estimate snapshots are MINOR findings because estimates may be stale.
For SCHEDULING reruns, Pass 2 checks _Schedule/ for post-amendment snapshot folders.
Missing post-change schedule snapshots are MINOR findings because schedule may be stale.
For each recommended rerun, Pass 2 records Agent, Scope, Evidence of Completion, and Status.
Pass 2 rerun status values are COMPLETED, NO_EVIDENCE, and NOT_APPLICABLE.
Pass 3 scans for references to entities affected by REMOVE, MERGE, or RECLASSIFY actions.
For each retired entity ID, Pass 3 searches all Dependencies.csv files under the execution root for active rows targeting that retired ID.
Pass 3 may use tools/coordination/analyze_dep_closure.py when available or manual CSV scanning otherwise.
Each active dependency targeting a retired deliverable is an orphaned reference with CRITICAL severity.
For RECLASSIFY actions that changed package, Pass 3 checks ANCHOR IMPLEMENTS_NODE rows reference the correct parent package.
For MODIFY actions that changed a deliverable name, Pass 3 checks other Dependencies.csv TargetName fields for stale name references.
Stale dependency TargetName references caused by MODIFY name changes are MINOR findings.
Pass 4 verifies that the current decomposition document state is consistent with the amendment.
For DOMAIN, Pass 4 runs validate_domain_decomposition_integrity.py against the active decomposition package and amendment snapshot.
Pass 4 incorporates DOMAIN integrity validator findings into decomposition-consistency results.
CRITICAL and MAJOR DOMAIN validator findings are blocking decomposition-consistency findings.
The DOMAIN validator covers annex referential integrity, cardinality, objective reconciliation, coverage telemetry, snapshot completeness, _LATEST.md parity, and KTY remediation rollup consistency.
Checks covered by the DOMAIN validator must not be restated as independent inline audit logic.
Pass 4 confirms the change log contains the amendment entry with the correct AMENDMENT_ID, date, and description.
Pass 4 confirms ADD, REMOVE, and RECLASSIFY scope item mappings reflect the post-change state.
Pass 4 validates scope mappings using DECOMP_VARIANT section binding.
Pass 4 confirms ADD and REMOVE package rows are present or annotated as RETIRED.
Pass 4 confirms all deliverable rows reflect the post-change state.
When pre-change and post-change coverage summaries exist, Pass 4 compares them for coverage regressions and new unassigned scope items.
Forward coverage should not regress unless the regression is caused by an intentional REMOVE action.
No new unassigned scope items should appear unless they come from an ADD action that has not yet fully propagated.
Pass 5 checks _CONTEXT.md for every deliverable affected by the scope change.
Pass 5 verifies affected deliverable Name and Package fields match the decomposition document.
Pass 5 verifies Discipline, Type, and Responsible fields when those fields were modified by the amendment.
Pass 5 verifies Decomposition Reference points to the correct decomposition document.
Pass 5 verifies Scope Traceability lists the correct SOW-IDs and OBJ-IDs per the Scope Ledger.
Pass 5 checks _STATUS.md for every deliverable affected by the scope change.
Pass 5 verifies lifecycle state is RETIRED for removed entities and at least OPEN for added entities.
Pass 5 verifies _STATUS.md history entries are consistent with the scope change timeline.
Pass 6 runs whenever any Amendment_Actions.csv row has SupersessionBindingPresent = YES.
If supersession files are missing while SupersessionBindingPresent = YES actions exist, Pass 6 emits a CRITICAL finding.
Pass 6 must not be skipped when required supersession files are absent.
For each SupersessionBindingPresent = YES row, Pass 6 derives the expected supersession decision identifier as D-{ActionSeq}.
Pass 6 verifies at least one Supersession_Delta.csv row exists with the same AmendmentID and derived DecisionID.
For decision-log-only bindings without a formal amendment action, Pass 6 accepts DL-{reference} rows as valid.
For every Supersession_Delta.csv row, Pass 6 verifies SupersededAuthorityPath resolves to an existing admitted authority file.
Every SUPERSESSION row must have a non-empty SupersededAuthorityRef pointing to a specific source location.
Pass 6 verifies cumulative supersession-map accumulation by invoking accumulate_supersession_map.py in check mode.
Pass 6 omits --delta when the audited SCA introduces no delta.
Pass 6 uses --allow-empty when no prior map and no current delta exist.
Pass 6 incorporates MISSING_EXPECTED_ROW and UNEXPECTED_ROW accumulator findings.
Surviving supersession-map rows must use canonical root names, canonical facility IDs, and explicit section IDs or an intentionally blank global scope.
A source-affecting action with no matching supersession row is a CRITICAL finding.
A supersession row with empty or unresolvable authority path, authority reference, or invalid applicability tokens is a MAJOR finding.
A SUPPLEMENTARY_EXTENSION row without SupersededAuthorityRef is a MINOR finding.
A scope-change snapshot with source-affecting decisions and incomplete supersession bindings should not be publication-ready.
Pass 7 runs when DECOMP_VARIANT is DOMAIN or when the amendment snapshot contains KTY_Remediation_Manifest.csv.
If an amendment affects KTY-local content, Pass 7 verifies KTY_Remediation_Manifest.csv exists in the amendment snapshot.
If no KTY remediation manifest exists and no KTY-local impact is recorded, Pass 7 is marked NOT_APPLICABLE.
If a required KTY remediation manifest is missing, Pass 7 emits a CRITICAL finding.
If validate_kty_remediation_manifest.py is available, Pass 7 runs it against the manifest and Amendment_Actions.csv.
Pass 7 incorporates blocking findings from validate_kty_remediation_manifest.py.
KTY remediation manifest required fields include EntityType, EntityID, KTYID, KTYPath, CONTENT_DISPOSITION_STATE, FACTUAL_USE_GATE, AUTHORITY_BASIS, SOURCE_ACTION_REF, and LAST_VERIFIED_AT.
KTY remediation manifest informational fields include AffectedSubjects, AffectedHBK, CanonicalRootName, and FacilityID.
Blank informational KTY remediation fields are valid only when the field is not applicable or the root or facility scope is unambiguous.
Allowed CONTENT_DISPOSITION_STATE values are PENDING, ARCHIVED_STUBBED, REGENERATED, VERIFIED, DEFERRED, BLOCKED, and NOT_REQUIRED.
PENDING KTY remediation rows are CRITICAL findings.
DEFERRED KTY remediation rows must include substantive blocker notes and cap factual readiness at regeneration-only.
BLOCKED KTY remediation rows must include evidence-backed blocker notes and cap factual readiness at no next phase.
Every ARCHIVE_AND_STUB, REGENERATE_CONTENT, and VERIFY_ONLY KTY remediation row must have resolvable evidence paths or explicit location TBD with blocker notes.
ARCHIVE_AND_STUB rows must have a non-empty resolvable ArchivePath or explicit blocker notes.
ARCHIVE_AND_STUB rows must cite kty-content-remediate evidence.
REGENERATE_CONTENT rows must cite domain-documents evidence with AUTHORITY_MODE: SCA_DRIVEN.
VERIFY_ONLY rows must cite kty-content-remediate verification evidence.
Pass 7 verifies archived copies exist for ARCHIVE_AND_STUB rows.
Root-level retired Scoping.md and KA-*.md paths listed by ARCHIVE_AND_STUB rows must begin with [RETIRED] tombstone stubs.
Tombstone stubs must cite the amendment ID, source action reference, and archive path.
.Archive/ content must not be treated as current factual authority.
FACTUAL_USE_GATE = ALLOW_FACTUAL_USE requires regenerated or verified evidence and no unresolved blockers.
FACTUAL_USE_GATE = REGEN_ONLY is inconsistent with ReadyForNextPhase values PHASE7_REVIEW or PUBLICATION_GATED.
FACTUAL_USE_GATE = BLOCK_FACTUAL_USE is inconsistent with closure claims permitting factual downstream use.
FACTUAL_USE_GATE = RETIRED_NO_FACTUAL_USE requires archived, tombstoned, or otherwise retired evidence.
Pass 7 inspects downstream allowlist, section-map, regeneration-input, and publication-input files named in the snapshot when present.
Pass 7 emits a MAJOR finding if a current-input surface includes .Archive/ as factual input.
Pass 7 emits an OBSERVATION if no downstream input surfaces are present for scanner-exclusion inspection.
Pass 8 compiles all findings from Passes 1 through 7.
A CRITICAL finding means a scope change action was not executed or an orphaned dependency targets a retired deliverable.
A MAJOR finding means a downstream rerun did not occur or metadata is inconsistent with the amendment.
A MINOR finding means a cosmetic inconsistency that does not affect integrity.
An OBSERVATION finding requires no action and is noted for completeness.
Closure status CLOSED requires zero CRITICAL findings and zero MAJOR findings.
Closure status CLOSED_WITH_OBSERVATIONS requires zero CRITICAL and MAJOR findings with at least one MINOR or OBSERVATION.
Closure status OPEN applies when one or more CRITICAL or MAJOR findings remain.
Pass 8 writes all output artifacts to the snapshot folder.
Pass 8 updates the _LATEST.md pointer.
Pass 8 returns a summary to RECONCILIATION.
A valid scope closure audit must locate the amendment snapshot and successfully parse Amendment_Actions.csv.
A valid scope closure audit must check every Amendment_Actions.csv row against filesystem state.
A valid scope closure audit must check every recommended downstream rerun for evidence of completion.
A valid scope closure audit must cover all retired entity IDs across all Dependencies.csv files during orphaned reference detection.
A valid scope closure audit must verify decomposition document consistency against the amendment record.
A valid scope closure audit must check context metadata for every affected deliverable against the decomposition.
A valid scope closure audit must verify supersession binding completeness for all source-affecting actions.
Supersession binding verification runs whenever any Amendment_Actions.csv row has SupersessionBindingPresent = YES.
For DOMAIN, a valid scope closure audit must verify KTY content remediation state against KTY_Remediation_Manifest.csv when present or required.
For DOMAIN, a valid scope closure audit must check .Archive/ scanner exclusion against downstream current-input surfaces where present.
For DOMAIN, decomposition integrity must be verified through validate_domain_decomposition_integrity.py.
For DOMAIN, supersession-map accumulation must be verified through accumulate_supersession_map.py when supersession inputs are in scope.
Every finding in a valid audit must have an EvidenceFile and SourceRef or explicit location TBD.
A valid audit must not silently resolve findings or conflicts between amendment record and filesystem state.
The issue log CSV must conform to the STRUCTURE-defined schema.
The summary JSON must include counts per severity and the overall closure status.
The snapshot folder must be immutable after creation.
A finding without evidence is invalid because it violates the evidence-first invariant.
Marking an action VERIFIED when filesystem state contradicts it is invalid.
Limiting the orphan scan to affected packages only is invalid because orphans may be in unrelated deliverables.
Silently resolving amendment/filesystem disagreement is invalid.
Expanding the audit scope beyond the specified amendment is invalid.
Ignoring a DOMAIN KTY remediation manifest is invalid.
Treating .Archive/ as current factual input is invalid.
An INIT-TASK brief for AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE must identify purpose, AMENDMENT_ID, execution root, scope change root, decomposition path, decomposition variant, constraints, and notes.
The scope closure audit root contains _LATEST.md and timestamped ScopeClosure_{AMENDMENT_ID}_{YYYY-MM-DD}_{HHMM}/ snapshot folders.
A scope closure audit snapshot contains Brief.md, Scope_Closure_Report.md, Scope_Closure_IssueLog.csv, scope_closure_summary.json, and QA_Report.md.
DOMAIN scope closure audit snapshots may include Domain_Integrity_Report.md and Domain_Integrity_Findings.csv tool outputs.
Pass 6 scope closure audit snapshots may include Expected_Supersession_Map.csv and Supersession_Map_Findings.csv.
Scope_Closure_IssueLog.csv uses IssueID values formatted as SCC-{NNN} sequentially within the audit.
Scope_Closure_IssueLog.csv records the pass number that found each issue.
Scope_Closure_IssueLog.csv Category values include action, downstream-rerun, orphan, decomposition, metadata, coverage, supersession, KTY remediation, and archive scanner leak categories.
Scope_Closure_IssueLog.csv Severity values are CRITICAL, MAJOR, MINOR, and OBSERVATION.
Scope_Closure_IssueLog.csv records the related amendment action or N/A for cross-cutting findings.
Scope_Closure_IssueLog.csv records EntityID, EvidenceFile, SourceRef, Description, Recommendation, and EpistemicLabel for each issue.

Scope closure summary JSON records amendment identity, audit date, closure status, action counts, rerun counts, orphan counts, content-remediation state, KTY counts, archive leaks, and findings by severity.
Scope_Closure_Report.md records audit metadata, amendment summary, pass results, closure determination, and recommendations.
The report template begins with the scope closure audit title, audit date, closure status, amendment date, and amendment description.
The report amendment summary reproduces the action summary from Amendment_Actions.csv.
The report Pass 1 section contains a table of ActionSeq, ActionType, EntityID, Expected, Actual, and Status.
The report Pass 2 section contains a table of Agent, Scope, Evidence, and Status.
The report Pass 3 section lists orphaned references or states that none were detected.
The report Pass 4 section includes decomposition-consistency findings and, for DOMAIN, validator status and findings summary.
The report Pass 5 section contains findings for each checked deliverable.
The report Pass 6 section contains findings for each checked supersession binding.
The report Pass 7 section contains manifest, evidence, archive/stub, factual-use gate, and .Archive/ scanner exclusion findings.
The report closure determination summarizes findings by severity and states overall closure status with rationale.
The report recommendations section lists prioritized remediation actions for OPEN findings.
QA_Report.md records coverage for checked actions, downstream reruns, dependency files scanned, context files checked, KTY manifest rows checked, and .Archive/ scanner exclusion surfaces checked.
QA_Report.md records limitations such as scope limitations, unreadable files, and unavailable tools.
QA_Report.md self-assessment states whether all passes completed, all findings have evidence, and no silent resolutions occurred.
Scope changes are high-risk because they modify project structure.
A closure audit verifies that downstream work caused by a scope change cascade has completed.
AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE runs later than the immediate SCOPE_CHANGE validation to verify downstream reruns after they have had time to execute.
The gap between applying a scope change and propagating all consequences is where inconsistency hides.
RECONCILIATION dispatches AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE because scope change closure is inherently cross-deliverable.
RECONCILIATION is the human-directed manager for cross-deliverable coherence.
RECONCILIATION uses a one-task-agent-at-a-time, human-directed toolbelt pattern for this audit.
A dependency row targeting a RETIRED deliverable is a live reference to a dead entity.
Orphaned references can cause dependency-closure audits, estimating, and scheduling to act on non-existent or unresolvable scope.
Detecting orphaned references is the single most important function of AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE.
Audit classification prioritizes integrity above completeness, precision, and efficiency.
A missed orphaned reference or unexecuted action is worse than a false positive.
Partial audits are worse than thorough audits.
Accurate severity classification enables efficient human triage.
OBSERVATION-level noise should be minimized to keep the report actionable.
